We Make It Easy
Nova Southeastern University will work with you every step of the admissions process.
To us, you’re more than a test score or GPA. While you're thinking about the best
way to reach your career goals, we're the one university truly dedicated to thinking
about and listening to you.
From our attentive professors and caring staff to outstanding academic and career
support services, we're here to help you make a plan for your future—and then make
it a reality. Start benefitting from the supportive environment we're known for, even
before you step onto campus as a new student.
Getting started is easy. We've streamlined the application process so you can self-report
your scores until you're admitted. Plus, you'll have a dedicated admissions counselor to help you navigate admissions and answer any questions you have.
We're here to answer your questions and look forward to getting to know you and the
unique talents and perspectives you'll bring to our tight-knit campus community.

Apply to the Honors Program for Fall 2027
Nova Southeastern University's Farquhar Honors Program provides a value-added experience for highly motivated and high-achieving undergraduate
students through curricular and co-curricular programs and activities. Membership
is by application only and is restricted to top students in each major.
Academically motivated students are encouraged to apply. Interested, qualified students
must complete and return this application to be considered.
Applications are reviewed on a continuing basis. They must be received no later than
May 1, 2027 for new or prospective students. Applications from current NSU students
must be received no later than March 1, 2027. You will receive email communication
with notification of a decision about your standing in the Honors Program.
Please Note: Your application to NSU must be accepted before submitting this application;
NSU student credentials are required to log in to the application platform. Current
students, please use your standard student login information as prompted. Incoming
students, please consult with your Admissions Counselor on how to obtain these credentials.
Apply Now to the Honors Program
